equivalence_note: 'Treasury funds and others' in the BoJ daily file IS the daily net fiscal flow (taxes/issuance in, spending/redemptions out) — a DTS at daily resolution, T+1 final with same-day provisional and next-day projection. Government deposits at the BoJ are small (MoF manages cash with T-Bills) and only ten-day.
